text: hey i made this mesh [Image #8] and painted it all up, i gave it two stored paintings actually one of them is clean the other is tagged up. for reuse, but ;_; i exported it into the world, and then when i pull it up to place it, it doesnt have either of the paintings D: [Image #9]

events.text: Root cause found: the live mesh-prop bridge (cart/editor/world/meshProps.ts) registered exported models UNTEXTURED (pngLen 0 — the file header literally said 'its own painted atlas is a later slice') and world_loader.zig applyLiveColliders only folded live BOX pieces into physics, never live MESH refs. Fixed both: resident push embeds atlases/base.png; live mesh refs emit per-island oriented colliders.

resolution: Fixed the two halves of the placed-export bug: (1) PAINT — pushResidentMeshes now reads the model package's atlases/base.png (resolvePackageDir by id) and embeds the PNG in the MESH_PROPS resident lump; the host decoder already supported the v4+ png block, so placements render painted exactly like baked cooked props. This half is pure JS and hot-reloads. (2) COLLISION — applyLiveColliders in world_loader.zig now also folds live MESH refs into the physics rebuild using the same per-island oriented boxes the baked mesh-prop path emits (walk-under banding preserved, ghost preview stays non-solid); needs a dev-host rebuild since it's Zig. Note: the placement wears the painting last saved on the model (base.png); per-placement CHOICE between stored paint variants (clean vs tagged) is a follow-up feature — today you'd apply the wanted painting in the mesh editor and re-export.
